p6_scope_boundary: P6 remains sufficient for the already-preregistered SBS-vs-P6 characterization claim. It is not sufficient for a broad claim over all modern 2026 scheduler classes without a separately preregistered modern-policy extension.
defensible_novelty_core: No audited prior work jointly characterizes production-derived resource pressure, canonical executable scheduler disagreement prevalence P(D), and default-relative one-step causal headroom P(B|D)/oracle_headroom for a fixed strong default scheduler.
claims_to_avoid: Do not claim first production workload characterization.
Do not claim first KV-aware or load-aware scheduler.
Do not claim learned selector generalization is established.
Do not claim real production deployment latency improvement.
Do not imply P6 exhausts all modern scheduler designs.

remaining_gates: Causal headroom remains pending until Phase-D execution.
Broader real-world workload coverage remains partial.
Real-system deployment-effect claims remain out of scope.
